example: Known tanks at40m/20s and90m/2s: before no immediate withdrawal; after fresh second contact qualifies. Stale-only contact remains pressure, not immediate overmatch.
implementation: One pass over existing bounded knowledge contacts independently retains remembered armour pressure and finds immediate overmatch. No live hostile geometry, new query/sort/worker or capability policy change. Usable AT and authored HOLD/SENTRY still veto overmatch.
